title: parse job payload

inputKey.description: Cache key (hex) of the stage's input (engine design §3.3).

slice.description: A parse job yields after 10 minutes at a range boundary and re-enqueues itself with slice + 1 (engine design §9.5).

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of a parse job: the parser-bound segment (parse, clean, chunk, personal-data) of one document (engine design §7.4, §9.1, §9.5).
